name: Angola
prevalence_note: The Banco Nacional de Angola has warned about fraudulent emails asking customers to 'update' data, and about social-media and phone offers of easy jobs, investments or credit that demand an upfront commission. Large banks also describe vishing that seeks PINs, passwords or urgent transfers.
cross_border_note: Calls and messages are usually in Portuguese and may use Angolan mobile numbers or spoofed bank identities.

scams.name: Vishing bancário e pedido de transferência
scams.name_en: Bank vishing and urgent transfer request

red_flag_keywords.text: asks for the card PIN during an unsolicited bank-style call
orders an urgent transfer into a so-called safe account
asks the customer to update account data over the phone

scams.signals_en: An unsolicited caller pretends to be a bank, already recites some personal details, and then asks for a card PIN, a homebanking password, or an immediate transfer, sometimes after a phishing email about 'updating customer information'.
scams.legit_en: Angolan bank security guidance on vishing says the bank will not ask for a card PIN or homebanking password on a call and will not order the customer to transfer money to another account. BNA has also flagged fraudulent 'update your data' emails.
bait_tactics: A aplicação do banco está presa no ecrã de entrada com fraca rede, portanto não consigo ver o movimento que descreveu.
O cartão e o código estão na outra divisão, e eu não recito PIN nenhum ao telefone.
Este pedido de transferência não corresponde a nenhuma operação que eu tenha iniciado no Multicaixa.

scams.name: Falso emprego, crédito ou investimento com comissão prévia
scams.name_en: Fake job, credit or investment with an upfront fee

red_flag_keywords.text: requires an upfront commission for a job, loan or placement
offers an immediate post at a supposed financial institution
promises guaranteed returns if a transfer is made at once

scams.signals_en: Messages or calls offer an immediate job at a supposed financial institution, or easy credit and high-yield placements, then tell the person to pay an initial commission; after the payment the contact disappears.
scams.legit_en: The Banco Nacional de Angola has described these social-media and telephone offers as fraudulent and tells the public to ignore the approach, not to exchange personal information, and to report the contacts to the competent authorities.
bait_tactics: Não vou pagar nenhuma comissão adiantada por um emprego ou crédito que apareceu nesta chamada.
O link da alegada instituição financeira não abre neste telemóvel, e eu não instalo aplicações a partir de uma conversa.
Não tenho kwanzas disponíveis nesta conta para uma taxa de activação que eu não contratei.
